scientific_integrity: The new claim is a double limit for positive detuning. The known \(b=1/2\) escape law and \(b<1/2\) antipodal two-cycle results are excluded. Finite checks supplement, but do not replace, analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact antidiagonal theorem for fixed \(a>0\) and \(r_0>\sqrt2\), in the supercritical regime \(b=1/2+\varepsilon\), \(\varepsilon\downarrow0\); no full-plane initial-data theorem or explicit uniform finite-detuning errors. Priority is limited to inspected sources.
title: A universal softplus escape clock near the critical coupling of a Gaussian map
